_meta.description: Scored early-entry signal stack. Each signal has a weight (0-1), threshold, and lead_time_est (minutes before crowd volume). Composite score = sum(weight * fire) / total_weight, scaled 0-100.
_meta.requires_backtest: engine/backtest.md — run against wallet_intel.db to calibrate thresholds and confirm lead times

signals.label: New pool creation / pump.fun graduation
signals.notes: Fires when a pool is created or graduates in the last N minutes. Strongest raw signal for meme tokens.

signals.label: Low bundler rat share at launch
signals.notes: High bundler share at launch = snipers loaded = likely dump after pump. Low bundler share is a GREEN signal.

signals.label: Dev wallet NOT dumping
signals.notes: Dev wallet holding = aligned incentives. Check token transfer patterns and liquidity seeding.

signals.label: Holder concentration curve (early pump signature)
signals.notes: Early pumps: top10 holds 30-65%. Below 30% = too distributed (no momentum). Above 65% = too concentrated (rug risk).

signals.label: Rising volume BEFORE price spike
signals.notes: Volume 2x+ in 5min while price <25% up = accumulation phase. This is THE lead indicator.

signals.label: OHLCV micro-structure: launch candle shape
signals.notes: Small wicks on launch candle = clean accumulation. Large upper wick = already being dumped.

signals.label: GMGN smart money / KOL buy
signals.notes: 2+ smart money wallets buying in 15min = strongest whale signal. Combine with radar watchlist for conviction boost.

signals.label: Whale cluster: ≥N watchlist wallets buying same token
signals.notes: Sourced from Lane 2 (Whale Radar). Cluster = strongest conviction signal for early entry.
